name: Jump squat

phases.name: down
phases.cue: Sink into a squat, arms swinging back

phases.name: land
phases.cue: Land softly and sink into the next squat

formTips: Squat until your thighs are about level
Keep your knees out over your toes
Swing your arms to drive the jump
Land softly on the balls of your feet, knees bent
commonMistakes: Knees caving in on the jump or landing
Rounding the back at the bottom
